purpose: Falsifiable local representation audit, never a production classifier or independent accuracy estimate.
sampling: First three existing production segment centres, continuous non-overlapping contexts; no label-dependent selection.

penultimate.pooling: L2 each 3s window, mean ten windows, L2 again

temporal.pooling: Mean time axis of frontend temporal channels, same window/segment L2 pooling

tags.role: fixed-head geometric baseline under identical normalization
tags.pooling: Sigmoid logits, same window/segment L2 pooling

comparison: Cosine distances, never learned coordinates, PCA selection, supervised head, centroid classifier or scalar threshold search.
stabilityGate: For every recording and representation, each segment's gain/offset cosine displacement must be less than half its nearest OTHER recording's base-segment distance. Gain invariance after RMS normalization is a preprocessing property, not learned robustness.
neighborhoodGate: Each of three base contexts must have an unambiguous nearest OTHER recording base context with the same feedback label. Perturbations must preserve the neighbor label. This is a calibration geometry diagnostic, NOT held-out classification accuracy; no same-recording segments are candidates.
identityGate: Audit same-artist attraction, opposite-label same-artist neighbors and availability of both labels outside the positive artist. Five SPORT recordings from one artist cannot establish artist-independent generalization. Passing stability or label neighborhoods alone never clears this gate.
stop: One checkpoint, one normalization, three predeclared representations, five conditions. No new checkpoint, feature/prompt/level search after observing these eight calibration recordings. Failure rejects a direct similarity deployment, not the possibility of information recoverable with independently labelled data.
privacy: Explicit local non-CUE manifest only; no implicit download, audio output file, upload, production cache or manual tag writes. Full vectors and private manifest stay in ignored artifacts.
labelProvenance: shared/testcases/workout-feedback.json: all eight are calibration, non-independent; no old coarse labels, calmness feedback or proxy danceability/arousal substituted as workout truth.
